cd /workspaces/semio && python3 -c "
import json
with open('semio/assets/semio/kit_metabolism.json') as f:
    kit = json.load(f)
print('Types:', len(kit.get('types', [])))
for t in kit.get('types', []):
    print(f'  Type: {t[\"name\"]} guid={t[\"guid\"]}')
    for m in t.get('models', []):
        print(f'    Model: guid={m[\"guid\"]} file={m.get(\"file\",{}).get(\"guid\",\"?\")[:16]}...')
print('Designs:', len(kit.get('designs', [])))
for d in kit.get('designs', []):
    print(f'  Design: {d[\"name\"]} guid={d[\"guid\"][:16]}... pieces={len(d.get(\"pieces\",[]))} conns={len(d.get(\"connections\",[]))} parent={d.get(\"parent\",{}).get(\"guid\",\"\")[:16] if d.get(\"parent\") else None}')
print('Files:', len(kit.get('files_', kit.get('files', []))))
for fi in kit.get('files_', kit.get('files', [])):
    blob = fi.get('blob', '')
    print(f'  File: {fi[\"name\"]} guid={fi[\"guid\"][:16]}... blob_len={len(blob) if blob else 0}')
"

import json
with open('semio/assets/semio/kit_metabolism.json') as f:

print('Types:', len(kit.get('types', [])))
for t in kit.get('types', []):
    print(f'  Type: {t[\"name\"]} guid={t[\"guid\"]}')
    for m in t.get('models', []):
        print(f'    Model: guid={m[\"guid\"]} file={m.get(\"file\",{}).get(\"guid\",\"?\")[:16]}...')
print('Designs:', len(kit.get('designs', [])))
for d in kit.get('designs', []):
    print(f'  Design: {d[\"name\"]} guid={d[\"guid\"][:16]}... pieces={len(d.get(\"pieces\",[]))} conns={len(d.get(\"connections\",[]))} parent={d.get(\"parent\",{}).get(\"guid\",\"\")[:16] if d.get(\"parent\") else None}')
print('Files:', len(kit.get('files_', kit.get('files', []))))
for fi in kit.get('files_', kit.get('files', [])):
    blob = fi.get('blob', '')
    print(f'  File: {fi[\"name\"]} guid={fi[\"guid\"][:16]}... blob_len={len(blob) if blob else 0}')
